opportunities.title: Regular Grants

amount.raw: Grants vary. Operating/core cost grants unlikely to fund more than 10% of an organisation's total annual budget. Project grants tend to be 10-20% of a total project cost. Capital grants normally no more than 10% of a total capital project cost; for local community projects (village halls, community centres, places of worship) grants are likely to be no greater than £30,000 regardless of project size.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt or excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidelines. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts as an eligible charity (independently audited/examined accounts or Charity Commission annual return). Must work inside the UK or UK Overseas Territories. Cannot fund work already undertaken. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after previous application outcome before applying again.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grants to UK charities for operating/core costs, specific projects/activity, or capital projects (building works, repairs, or equipment). Applications accepted continuously via the online Grants Portal.

opportunities.title: Major Grants

amount.raw: For grants of £100,000 and over. The total cost of what is being applied for must be at least £1 million. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Same core eligibility as Regular Grants (UK registered charities, CIOs, exempt/excepted organisations, at least one year of accounts, working in the UK/UKOTs). For core costs, annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital or project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply via the regular grant route instead.
opportunities.summary: Major grant route for applications of £100,000 and over, where the total project cost is at least £1 million. Applicants submit a Major Grant Expression of Interest Form via the Grants Management Portal, followed by bespoke guidance and a call if potentially suitable.
